name: pubnet-state-eviction-p23
description: Five protocol 23 pubnet ledgers inside a mass Soroban state-archival event, each evicting 2000 keys. The only committed fixture producing evicted_keys rows. Located by scanning 59,000,000-59,002,000, where 990 of 2000 ledgers evict and 1,970,054 keys are evicted in total; sampling 400-ledger windows at protocol 20, 22, 23, 25 and 27 elsewhere found none, so eviction is bursty rather than steady.
format: bare concatenated LedgerCloseMeta XDR, zstd -19 (--storage-type XDR after decompression)
